claims.content: The Auctioneer manages authorized users for the auction administration application by listing existing users, creating new user accounts, and editing user profiles including their specific system permissions and administrator status.

goal.raw_text: The Auctioneer manages authorized users for the auction administration application by listing existing users, creating new user accounts, and editing user profiles including their specific system permissions and administrator status.

claims.content: Auctioneer
The Auctioneer must be logged into the auction administration application to access the Administration Menu where User Access Management is located.

There must be at least two administrators in the system before any changes are made that could reduce the number of administrators to one or zero, as the system prevents an administrator from being the sole administrator.
The Auctioneer selects the User Access Management option from the Auction Administration Main Menu.

trigger.raw_text: The Auctioneer selects the User Access Management option from the Auction Administration Main Menu.

claims.content: The Auctioneer selects the 'User Access Management' option from the Administration Menu.
The system displays the User Access Management page containing two options: 'List All Users' and 'Create New User'.
To view existing users, the Auctioneer clicks the 'List All Users' button.
The system displays the 'List All Users' page showing a table of authorized users with columns for Last Name, First Name, Title, Login ID, Admin status, Delete, and Edit.
To create a new account, the Auctioneer clicks the 'Create New User' button from the main UAM page.
To edit an existing user, the Auctioneer clicks the 'Edit' button corresponding to the user in the 'List All Users' table.
The system navigates to the 'Create or Edit User' page where the Auctioneer enters or modifies user details such as First Name, Last Name, Title, Email Address, and Password.
The Auctioneer sets the user's access level by selecting either 'Administrator' (full access) or 'User' (access based on specific permissions like Create New Auctions, Edit Auctions, etc.).
The Auctioneer clicks the 'Save Changes' button to finalize the creation or update of the user profile.

If the Auctioneer attempts to change a user's access level such that they would become the sole administrator, the system prevents this action to ensure there is always a minimum of two administrators.
When the Auctioneer clicks the 'Delete' button for a user, the system displays a confirmation dialogue box asking to confirm the deletion before proceeding.

If the Auctioneer attempts to change a user's access level or delete a user such that they would become the sole administrator, the system prevents this action to ensure there is always a minimum of two administrators.

When the Auctioneer clicks the 'Delete' button for a user, the system displays a confirmation dialogue box asking 'You have chosen to delete user [Name]. Are you sure?' with 'Yes, Delete User' and 'Cancel' buttons; if 'Cancel' is selected, the deletion is aborted.
The user account is successfully created, updated, or deleted in the system as requested by the Auctioneer.
The user's access level is set to either 'Administrator' (full access) or 'User' with specific permissions granted via Yes/No radio buttons.
The system ensures there is always a minimum of two administrators, preventing any action that would result in a sole administrator.
If a user is deleted, they are removed from the 'List All Users' table after confirmation.
